messages:
sam_marketing: Quick heads-up — we're targeting next Wed 11:00am PT for the public announce of v0.9.3. Need final changelog, docs links, benchmark narrative blurb, and a confirmed webinar slot. Can engineering and docs confirm timelines?

ev an_engineering: We can freeze the changelog by Tue 12pm PT. I'll open the PR tonight: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/421.

priya_docs: Working on the docs PR — almost done with the upgrade guide and getting-started example. Aim to have published links by Tue 5pm PT (will ping here when live).

marco_growth: Marketing needs: canonical changelog URL + one short bulletsheet (3-4 bullets) describing perf wins to use in the announcement and social. Also want one sentence for the webinar CTA.

ev an_engineering: Perf wins bullets: 1) 2.5x throughput vs previous default, 2) 30% lower per-token cost with KV caching enabled, 3) stable p99 latency under our canary load. I'll drop those into the PR.

sam_marketing: Perfect. Also routing question — when the signups hit Intercom/HubSpot we need to route high-importance leads to AE queue and the rest to SDR. Marco can you confirm the form fields we need?

marco_growth: We'll need: company size, deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private), expected QPS, and 'priority for contact' checkbox. Add hidden field utm_campaign=0.9.3-launch. I'll share the HubSpot list mapping.

kai_ops: For rollout timing: suggested canary at Wed 11:10am PT on a small cohort (10% of prod traffic), ramp to 50% at 11:40am, full at 12:15pm. If we see error rate >1% or p99 spikes >200ms we auto-roll back. Deploy-bot will post updates.

priya_docs: Docs links to publish: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/0.9.3/changelog and https://docs.redwood.ai/setup/kv-caching-guide. I'll paste final URLs here when they're live.

sam_marketing: Webinar plan: Wed 11:00am PT is tight — can we run the webinar at 12:30pm PT same day? Need speaker: Evan + Priya + 15–20 min Q&A. Is that doable?

ev an_engineering: 12:30pm works for me. I'll prep a short demo of the new batching and KV cache. Priya can do the walkthrough of docs/upgrade steps.

priya_docs: Yep. I'll pull together a one-page slide with upgrade checklist and sample config. Will link to a sample policy snippet in the slides.

sam_marketing: Awesome. Action items for this thread: 1) Evan — finalize perf bullets + changelog PR by Tue 12pm PT. 2) Priya — publish docs links by Tue 5pm PT. 3) Marco — share HubSpot field mapping and form. 4) Kai — confirm deploy windows & rollback thresholds. 5) I'll draft the announcement copy and webinar CTA once we have final URLs.

marco_growth: I'll also set up the registration form and share test submission; please test routing by Wed 9am PT.

kai_ops: Deploy-bot: starting canary monitor at 11:10am PT.

deploy-bot: [automated] Canary monitor configured — thresholds: error_rate>=1%, p99_latency>=200ms -> notify #eng-oncall and pause rollout. Logs: https://internal.redwood.ai/deploys/0.9.3/canary

sam_marketing: Minor ask — include a short benchmark snippet for the announcement: one graph (tokens/sec) + 2-sentence take. Evan can you attach an SVG or point to Grafana panel?

ev an_engineering: I'll export the tokens/sec panel and drop the SVG into the PR assets. Will also add a 2-sentence narrative: "Optimized kernel selection plus KV prefix caching gives up to 2.5x sustained throughput for typical chat workloads while keeping p99 latency under target."

priya_docs: Uploaded docs now: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/0.9.3/changelog (live) and https://docs.redwood.ai/setup/kv-caching-guide (live).

sam_marketing: Nice, thank you — those are the canonical links I need.

marco_growth: Test form submitted and landed in HubSpot sandbox — marco_growth@redwood.test. Routing looked good: high-priority -> AE queue, others -> SDR pool.

sam_marketing: Great. Evan, once you finish the PR please paste the changelog canonical URL. We'll cut the draft announce 24h before publish for legal + security review.

ev an_engineering: Changelog URL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/releases/tag/v0.9.3. PR updated with perf bullets and SVG asset.

sam_marketing: OK — schedule checklist: Tue 12pm PT changelog freeze, Tue 5pm PT docs live, Wed 9am PT form/routing test, Wed 11:10am PT canary start, Wed 12:30pm PT webinar, Wed 1:00pm PT public announce. Any blockers?

kai_ops: No blockers from infra. Will monitor canary and post in #eng-oncall.

marco_growth: No blockers. Will stand up registration landing + UTM tracking.

priya_docs: No blockers. Slide + one-pager will be in the docs PR by Tue EOD.

sam_marketing: Perfect — I'll draft the announcement and share in this thread for review. :thumbsup:

marco_growth: :clap:

priya_docs: :rocket:

end of thread
